title: fix(runtime): a flow start input declared a record id is loaded in the caller's own scope from the declared object at every door that starts the flow by name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgVwQPWq8KXvAdGshdRR8iSy)_
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbNMpDS92ifzhDw9vf

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：流程启动输入上写了 `objectName`（声明“这个输入是某对象一条记录的 id”）后，凡是按名字启动流程的入口（触发路由新旧两种写法、REST 与 MCP 的流程型动作、声明的流程型端点），都会先用调用者自己的权限从声明的对象里加载这条记录：读不到或不存在答 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`，不是 id 答 400 并点名该输入，两种情况都不会创建运行。没写声明的输入保持原样。
- 为什么改：执行 #29425 裁定 A（6663860762，C 撤回）：声明的记录引用要和流程定义里“明显当作 id 读”的输入一样被检查。
- 风险与回滚：收窄。以前能启动的流程，若声明的输入给了调用者读不到的 id，现在被拒。仓内已发布的流程声明这个键的数量为 0。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/flow-start-admission.ts` 的 `declaredReadsOf` 新增的声明读取（与可见读取取并集、跟随子流程）；`packages/spec/liveness/flow.json` 的 `variables.objectName` 行翻为 live；测试文件末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/flow-start-declared-record-reads.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件 90 个用例全绿，其中 7 号 describe 每个入口下 7 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #29425

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a start that ran before is now refused when it hands a declared record-id input an id the caller cannot read in the declared object, an id that names no record there, or a value that is not one id.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the published skills do not teach the start-door record rule or the `objectName` input declaration: `git grep -n -i -E "record reference|isInput: true, objectName|declared record|liveness-planned" -- 'skills/**'` has one unrelated hit (`skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md:52`, a redirect URL's record fields).

## What changes

The rule: **a flow start input that declares it is the id of a record of a named object (`objectName` on the variable) is loaded, at every door that starts the flow by name, from the declared object in the caller's own scope before the run exists. An unreadable or nonexistent id is refused `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`; a value that is not one id is refused `400` naming the input. An undeclared input keeps the visible-read rule unchanged.**

- **One helper, no door edits.** Every door already asks the shared check that PR #29365 introduced: `refuseUnreadableFlowStartRecords` (`action-execution.ts`), which loads each input from every object `flowDeclaredRecordReads` (`flow-start-admission.ts`) says the run reads it from. `declaredReadsOf` now adds the declaration as one more read, `{ object: objectName, many: false }`. Door population, measured on `main` `2ffdb649` and unchanged since #29365:

  | Door | Entrances | Calls the shared check at |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | trigger route | `POST /automation/:name/trigger` and the legacy `POST /automation/trigger/:name`, both through `respondToFlowTrigger` | `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:2824` |
  | action of `type: 'flow'` | REST `POST /actions/:object/:action` and MCP `run_action`, both through `dispatchFlowAction` | `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:2685` |
  | declared endpoint of `type: 'flow'` | the endpoint executor | `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.ts:590` |

  Other `execute(flowName, …)` callers are engine-internal (the `subflow` and `map` nodes, trigger bindings) or the verify harness, none of them a door.
- **Declared and also read in plain sight against another object: both are judged.** The declaration is added beside every visible read, never in place of one. If it replaced them, a run that reads object B under the same id would read a row nobody checked, which is the gap #29365 closed. So a caller must be able to read the row in both objects.
- **Followed into callees.** A parent that hands its input on, unchanged, to a `subflow` or `map` callee whose input carries the declaration is judged by that declaration, through the same recursion as other callee reads.
- **A `loop` or `map` that rebinds the name does not withdraw a declaration.** The shadowing rule exists because a rebound name no longer holds the caller's value when a node reads it. The declaration is about the value the caller sent, so it stands.
- **`packages/spec` (seat-authorised, minimal).** The `objectName` liveness row (`packages/spec/liveness/flow.json` › `variables.objectName`) flips from `planned` + `authorWarn` to `live`, with this reader as its evidence. The describe and docblock on `FlowVariableSchema.objectName` drop their planned sentences. Both the row and the docblock said to do this "in the commit that lands the reader". Left as they were, `os validate` would go on warning `liveness-planned-property` on every flow that declares the key, and the describe would say that no door applies it. The regenerated artifacts are `content/docs/references/{automation/flow,api/automation-api}.mdx` and `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/flow.md`. No key, type or accepted value changes.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`: the "Planned, no door applies this yet" callout under *A start input that is a record id* is replaced by the rule, and the `404` row under *Run a flow via API* names declared inputs.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/29425-declared-record-input.md`, patch for `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/spec`, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

**Why the title carries no `!`.** No flow shipped in this repository declares the key today. `git grep` over `examples/`, `packages/` and `apps/` for an input variable literal that carries `objectName` finds only CHANGELOG example text. An input without the declaration answers exactly as before.

## Why

Ruling A on #29425 (6580257050, A half kept by 6663860762, which withdrew C): a flow start input may declare a record reference, and every door that starts the flow by name loads a declared input in the caller's scope before the run exists, with the refusals #29365 gives a visibly read input. The spec half (#29442) landed the key. This is the server half.

## Tests

New top-level describe 7, *a start input declared a record id is loaded from the declared object at every door, before the run exists*, in `packages/runtime/src/flow-start-declared-record-reads.test.ts`, the shared harness of #29365. It uses that file's row-scoped double, where each row is visible only to its owner. Per door (both trigger spellings, the endpoint, REST action, MCP `run_action`):

- a declared input naming a readable record: the run starts, and the declared object was loaded (the firing control);
- naming a record the caller cannot read, and an id that names nothing: `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, `execute()` never called;
- given an object, a list or a boolean: `400` naming `contractId`, nothing loaded from the declared object, no run;
- the same input undeclared and read by no node: not judged, the run starts on an id the caller cannot read (today's behaviour, the control).

Also pinned: the reading (`flowDeclaredRecordReads`) for a declaration, a declaration beside a visible read of another object, a callee's declaration, and a loop that rebinds the name; the union at a door (readable in the declared object only → `404`; readable in both → run); a parent handing its input to a callee's declared input → `404`; the system principal → run, nothing loaded.

**Forced test edits** (`packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`, test-only). Two pins read the shipped ledger's `planned` state of this row. Flipping the row is what makes them false.
- The #29442 pin *warns on a flow input declared a record reference* becomes *no longer warns … live since the start doors read it*. It follows the same shape the file already uses for the `params.widget` flip.
- The `params.widget` pin used this row as its control ("the walk still warns on a drilled planned row"). Both pins now take that control from the other shipped `planned` + `authorWarn` drilled row, an app navigation entry's `dataSource`.

## Acceptance notes

- **At an action door, a param's own type answers first.** A declared action param of type `text` that holds an object, a list or a boolean is refused by the action's param contract (ADR-0104 D2), `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the param, before the start check is reached. The trigger routes and the endpoint answer `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` from the start check. Either way the refusal is a 400 that names the input, nothing is loaded and no run starts. The pins assert the code per door.
- **Author contradiction, not judged here.** An input declared one id that the definition also reads as a list (`filter.id.$in`) gets both readings, so no value satisfies it and every start is refused `400`. This is loud, not silent, and it is a lint candidate. It is not part of this rule.
- **The object-less key.** `objectName: 'global'` passes the spec's name pattern. The shared subject load treats `global` and `*` as the object-less action key and loads nothing, so an input declared against `global` is not judged. This is the same pre-existing behaviour as a visible read of an object named `global`, and it is noted, not changed.

## Verification

Readings on head `469106e8f` (after merging `origin/main`) unless stated; the ablations and the first runtime suite ran on `c55e8047`, before the merge.

<details><summary>Pins, ablations</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/flow-start-declared-record-reads.test.ts` under the verify lock: `Tests  90 passed (90)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ablation 1, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete`, on the line that adds the declaration (`add(variable.name, { object: variable.objectName, many: false });`). The anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob from `2b18eb885049` to `945bcd4535b1`. Result: `Tests  30 failed | 60 passed (90)`. Red: every door's readable / unreadable / nonexistent pin, the trigger and endpoint 400 pins, the union and the callee pins, and the four reading pins. Green as designed: the action-door 400 pins (the param contract answers first), every undeclared control, and the system principal. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, a declaration that replaces the visible reads (`inputs.add(variable.name);` made conditional on no `objectName`). Blob `2b18eb885049` to `cbe9b748c523`. Result: `Tests  2 failed | 88 passed (90)`, the two union pins. Restored, blob equals HEAD.
- The test imports the helper from `src/` by relative path, so no `dist` leg applies.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (before merging `main`): `Test Files  547 passed (547)`, `Tests  9911 passed | 19 skipped (9930)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files  195 passed (195)`, `Tests  8103 passed (8103)` on `469106e8f`; the declared-input pin file again `Tests  90 passed (90)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0 (after building `@objectstack/driver-turso`, which a runtime kernel test imports and the closure build had not produced).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the five changed source and test files: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts current after `gen:docs` and `gen:liveness-counts`, and again after merging `main`.
</details>

<details><summary>Full dogfood battery</summary>

- `469106e8f` · closure build `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` exit 0, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0` · `Test Files  420 passed | 3 skipped (423)` · `Tests  3496 passed | 36 skipped (3532)` · no failures.
</details>

<details><summary>Dispatch gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `469106e8f`: 105 commands (11 paths, 417 changed lines, under the 3000-line threshold). Each ran with stdin from /dev/null and its exit code captured before any pipe: 105 exit 0.
- `--ran`: `105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- On the pre-merge head `c55e8047`, three had refused with exit 3 for prerequisites: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone; fixed by fetching its fixture commit), `check:skill-examples` (`client-react` unbuilt) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (workspace unbuilt). All three read exit 0 on `469106e8f` after the closure build.
- CI check-runs: not read at the time of writing.
</details>

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the changed files; the repo-wide run is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. (The two reference pages are generator output.)
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 section is Chinese by the repo's maintainer rule.)
